posts.cooked:
Hey everyone, if this has been addressed somewhere can someone just point me to it, because I haven't seen anything about it. In the recent kickstarter update, as well as the State of Game post a few days ago, it was stated that nothing was shipping to backers yet. Well, I backed the OblivAeon project at The Entire Multiverse level and received a box in the mail today.

https://imgur.com/t13UNOG

Looks like I received the Core Game, Rook City & Infernal Relics, Shattered Timelines & Wrath of the Cosmos, Vengeance, Villains, The Foil hero card pack, Scholar, Unity, Guise, Chokepoint, Miss Information, Wager Master, Ambuscade, Silver Gulch, Ominitron IV, The Final Wasteland, Celestial Tribunal, an extra token pack, and the oversized villain cards pack.

I *think* this is all the pre-OblivAeon stuff (Please correct me if I'm wrong). My question is, is this what's supposed to be happening and I'm supposed to get this stuff now with the rest of it coming in another shipment later? Just kind of nervous that my order might be screwed up since it's been reiterated a few times that "nothing!" has been shipped to backers.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: We sent out most of the "everything ever" shipments back in 2016. However, people who ordered later via BackerKit, or who updated their addresses after that ship deadline, had not had their stuff sent out until now. We have decided to send all of those now, before OblivAeon arrives, because it will make it faster to get OblivAeon out to all of the backers, even though we'll wind up paying a bit extra in shipping.
